Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
"Sorrow" <cbo...@apdi.net> writes:
>Can you play Immortal Grapple on the second round? Even if you didn't play
>it on the first?
>Also, can if you did play an IG on the first round, can you play another
>one at the beginning of the 2nd round? (so you can gain the optional
>press)

Yes. Yes.
Yes.

The new (sabbat) wording makes things a little clearer:

Immortal Grapple Combat Potence
Normal: Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. Only hand
strikes may be used for the remainder of combat.
Superior: As above, with an optional press. If another round of combat
occurs, that round is at close range; skip the establish range step
for that round.
